definitions.gloss: early, ahead of time, on the early side
definitions.explanation: Earlier than usual or expected; with time to spare. Used to indicate doing something before the deadline or expected time.

examples.japanese: {早|はや}めに{出発|しゅっぱつ}しましょう。
{早|はや}めに{予約|よやく}した{方|ほう}がいいですよ。
examples.english: You should make a reservation early.

examples.japanese: {早|はや}めに{寝|ね}て、{風邪|かぜ}を{治|なお}そう。
examples.english: Let's go to bed early and cure this cold.

notes:
FORMATION: {早|はや}い (early) + め (somewhat, -ish) + に (adverb marker)

The 〜め pattern indicates 'on the ~ side' or 'somewhat ~':
- {大|おお}きめ (on the large side)
- {小|ちい}さめ (on the small side)
- {遅|おそ}め (on the late side)

NUANCE: {早|はや}めに suggests being prudently early or giving oneself extra time, rather than extremely early.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {早|はや}めに{出|で}る/{出発|しゅっぱつ}する (leave early)
- {早|はや}めに{予約|よやく}する (book early)
- {早|はや}めに{寝|ね}る (go to bed early)
- {早|はや}めに{準備|じゅんび}する (prepare early)
